scope: Whole up/gate projection mapping redesign; quantized activation ownership, TRF extent, weight/scale DMA, DPE and reduction layouts change together. Down/GeGLU are reused, not claimed redesigned.
methods_selected: C07/E104 runtime E5M2 three-term activation and materialized FP8 weights
C04/E79 column-aware ring leader distribution mechanism
F32 block-scale partials and F32 column reduction before BF16 output
methods_removed: Full H=3840 activation replicated at all 512 up/gate slices
30 output rows per slice with no input column splitting
E104 full-H row-only contraction and direct row gather
graph: pre-RMS -> unchanged global-scale three-term quantizer -> two H-column anchors/ring broadcast -> each slice owns 60 rows x 1920 inputs -> FP4 to FP8 -> native term/block DPE -> F32 scale/local H sum -> two-column F32 sum -> canonical row gather -> BF16 -> unchanged GeGLU/E79 down and epilogue

layout.local_scale: 60 x 120, no local scale padding; 120-byte HBM column offset and DM row stride are divisible by 8
layout.scale_tile: 12 rows x 120 F32, 5760 bytes VRF; packed eight-lane load then four-lane vector operation
layout.row_output: 60 F32 rows at each group leader; gather before BF16

prior_related: C04 varied down columns; this changes both up/gate producer and consumer, previously row-only
C07 upgate contig/row2 layouts retained full H at each slice
C11 split row dots to retain VRF partials and grew dot count; here one large dot per projection is kept, while scale is tiled
cost_removed: Per-slice quantized input and TRF extent shrink from 11520 to 5760 logical bytes, half of E104.
Compared with failed v2, no 60-to-64 scale-row padding and only five scale passes.
cost_added: Strided 960-byte FP4 H subrows instead of complete 1920-byte rows.
Two-column F32 reduction and leader-to-canonical output gather.
Materialized FP8 weights and F32 block partials remain; no claim they disappear.
cost_evidence: E104 compiled input ring stream 11783 and each native dot 5684 cycles; these overlap other work and are not direct savings. A full NPU A/B discriminates reduced activation traffic versus the added transfer/reduction costs.
stop_condition: Repair concrete shape/axis/API errors, inspect the full schedule, then one unchanged benchmark screen when executable. Stop measured regression or sub-5% target gain without a sweep unless a distinct supported cost repair is identified.
repair: v2 fixed fetch packets but scale HBM->DM fails shared H factorization with 60#64 local blocks. Four-column scale start offsets would additionally be 60 bytes, not multiples of 8. v3 changes ownership to two columns: 120-byte aligned scale subrows, no padding, 60 local output rows, packed 8-lane scales. This concrete transfer and VRF-cost repair retains the new column-owned projection; it is not a new candidate family.
